mapper.sql: cmt_id, eid, uid, cmt, p_cmt_id, status, c_date, u_date
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_event_cmt ( eid, uid, cmt, p_cmt_id, status, c_date, u_date ) VALUES ( #{eid}, #{uid}, #{cmt}, #{parentCmtId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{cDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{uDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
SELECT currval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tb_event_cmt', 'cmt_id'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_event_cmt SET cmt = #{cmt}, status = #{status}, u_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cmt_id = #{cmtId}
